{"description":"Gap source `prohibition_in_prose` in crates/reflow2-core/src/detect.rs (`detect_prohibitions_in_prose`, `PROHIBITION_PHRASES`).

THE RULE: one aggregate finding over every live Requirement, Capability, Component, Interface and ACCEPTED Decision whose name, statement, description or decision text contains one of six phrases — "must never", "must not ever", "is not allowed to", "are not allowed to", "never allowed", "is forbidden" — case-insensitively, and which no Constraint CONSTRAINS. Severity 0.35, beside unreviewed_ideas: nothing is wrong, the intent is recorded and findable; it is in a home no computation reads. Aggregate on purpose and from measurement — ≈61 at once on this design; per node it is the BL-73 wallpaper. Stable aggregate id, so one acknowledgement is a judgement about the practice. The matched phrase rides into the evidence per node, and the evidence carries the denominator (nodes scanned).

DELIBERATE EXCLUSIONS, each pinned by a test that fails when the rule is widened: proposed Decisions (brainstormed ideas — the brainstorm skill's own rule is that detectors do not run over them; once accepted, the same sentence IS scanned); DesignRules (a "we never…" there is home by the routing table's other row) and Constraints (the home itself); ChangeEvents, TemporalFacts and Verifications (records and checks, not intent — "the one direction this must never fail in" on a test was in the measured sample); the `rationale` field (the why, not the what); parked nodes; nodes some Constraint already binds. "shall not" is deliberately NOT matched: it is the standard negative form of an obligation in requirement writing and an SE reader files it as a Requirement — a false neighbour is worse than a missing one. The closed-set row ("may only be A, B or C") is not matched: "exactly one of" is ordinary API prose here and would flood.

Silent on a design with none of the scanned types — an empty design has not declined to file its prohibitions. Reports absence of a record and never judges the sentence (dec:report-dont-judge): `add_constraint` + `constrains`, or an acknowledgement that the phrase was incidental, is the reader's call, and the finding says not to file a Constraint just to clear the count.

No regex crate in core and none added: six fixed phrases, lowercase substring.","name":"A prohibition living in prose is noticed, once, as a practice","provenance":"authored","status":"realized"}
